name: What is lower countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lower countertop installation involves fitting and securing new countertops at a reduced height, typically below the standard 36 inches. This modification can improve accessibility for individuals using wheelchairs, children, or those who prefer a lower working surface in kitchens or other areas. It requires careful planning to ensure proper integration with cabinets, appliances, and plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lower countertop installation is fitting new countertops at a reduced height for improved accessibility or preference.
